subject.title: fix(agents): add lock release timeout on attempt teardown

question: Should the canonical in-process recovery contract be implemented on this branch, or consolidated into the takeover-fenced abort-path work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90065?
rationale: Both branches target unsettled retained writes, but they choose different lifecycle entry points and ownership-fencing behavior; merging both independently would leave competing controller contracts.

options.title: Consolidate on takeover fencing
options.body: Use the controller-owned bounded release and takeover-poisoning design as the canonical path, adapting whichever branch is retained and closing the redundant implementation after positive proof.

options.title: Repair this teardown path
options.body: Keep this branch, but wire the helper into attempt teardown and add an equivalent ownership-revocation fence before releasing the lock.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Hold both implementations until a maintainer defines a single lock-release invariant and deterministic integration scenario.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on takeover fencing
recommendation.body: Use the controller-owned bounded release and takeover-poisoning design as the canonical path, adapting whichever branch is retained and closing the redundant implementation after positive proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The session-lock history and current discussion make this the strongest available owner for choosing the lock ownership contract.
